target_customer: B2B marketing, sales and revenue teams at software and services companies, including enterprise accounts
problem: B2B teams cannot tell which marketing and sales interactions drive revenue because data is spread across CRM, ad, product and web tools.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for revenue analytics and attribution, expanding to AI revenue agents

founders.name: Buğra Gündüz
education: Started college in the US and left in the first quarter to build HockeyStack
founders.background_notes: Per the YC page he sold digital products online in high school in Turkey.

founders.name: Arda Bulut
founders.background_notes: No background on the YC page.

founders.name: Emir Atlı
founders.background_notes: Named as co-founder in the YC launch post and as CRO on the Bessemer page.

competitors.name: Bizible
competitors.what: B2B revenue attribution, owned by Adobe

technical_complexity.rationale: A cookieless tracking script plus integrations across CRM, ad and product data and attribution models is standard data engineering with some hard identity resolution problems.

defensibility.rationale: Accumulated customer data and integrations create lock in, but attribution tools are numerous and HubSpot offers native attribution.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Incumbents offered native attribution and Adobe owned Bizible; the company still reached 130+ customers by Jan 2025 and 300+ later by its own account.

market_need_then: Competitors such as Dreamdata and Bizible were already selling B2B attribution in 2022, which shows paid demand. Axios reports the platform managing more than 20 billion dollars of campaign spend for 130+ customers by January 2025.

identity.voice_and_tone: Revenue intelligence for B2B teams; large customer logo wall.

branding.community_and_virality: Publishes comparison and template content, such as the Bizible versus Dreamdata guide, to drive search traffic.

brand_strength.rationale: Distinctive name, strong enterprise logos and funding press, but no source shows the brand itself as the growth driver.

pivots.to: AI Revenue Agents for the enterprise
pivots.why: Announced with the April 2026 funding per Pulse 2.0; company site now describes a revenue data platform with AI agents.

outcome_analysis: HockeyStack grew from a three founder YC S23 team to a 32 person company with a 2.7 million dollar seed in November 2023 and a 20 million dollar Series A led by Bessemer in January 2025, plus a reported 50 million dollar raise in April 2026. Enterprise logos and 130+ customers by early 2025 indicate strong demand, while unverified aggregator reports of layoffs and headcount decline are a caution.
notes: Seed 2.7M Nov 2023 is from search snippets citing FinSMEs, SaaS News and the founders' write-up; the Seedtable page returned 403. StartupIntros says 3M, the outlier. The 2026 round stage is not stated reliably (one outlet calls it a Series A); recorded as other. BVP page confirmed the 20M Series A but did not name other investors; Axios did. CB Insights total 23.2M and ZoomInfo 22.7M predate 2026. Aggregator layoff and traffic decline claims are unverified. Competitor rows come from HockeyStack's own 2022 comparison post, so they are a company framing of the field. YC page says founded 2022, structured data on the site says 2020; one outlet says 2021.
